{{Quote|Sergeant Boom-Boom, I like to use against the Empire. Buy a Republic world another day of peace.|Corso Riggs|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Sergeant Boom-Boom''' was a weapon owned by a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] named [[Corso Riggs]] by the end of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and into the following [[Galactic War]], fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. While serving with a [[Voidhound|smuggler captain]] who worked as a [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] for the Republic, Riggs preferred using Sergeant Boom-Boom against the forces of the Empire.

==History==
{{Quote|Then me and Sergeant Boom-Boom'll be right there with you, Captain.|Corso Riggs, to the smuggler captain|<ref name="TOR" />}}
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Corso Riggs]] gave the name Sergeant Boom-Boom to one of the weapons [[Gender/Legends|he]] owned by the end of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Riggs was in possession of the weapon while he served with the crew of a [[Voidhound|smuggler captain]]<ref name="The Peace Brigade" /> who worked for the Republic as a [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] beginning<ref name="Port Nowhere">{{TORcite|type=class|Smuggler|Port Nowhere|Port Nowhere}}</ref> in [[3642 BBY]]<ref name="Date" /> and into the following [[Galactic War]].<ref name="Heist of the Millenium">{{TORcite|type=class|Smuggler|Heist of the Millennium|The King's Ransom}}</ref> Sergeant Boom-Boom was the weapon that Riggs favored using against Imperial opponents by the [[Time/Legends|time]] the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] was working as a Republic privateer.<ref name="In Harm's Way">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Corso Riggs|In Harm's Way}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|If you want, you can borrow Sergeant Boom. He makes anyone look intimidating&hellip;|Cut dialogue of Corso Riggs speaking to the smuggler captain|<ref name="TOR" />}}
Sergeant Boom-Boom is first mentioned in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]]&ndash;[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in two companion conversations between a Smuggler player and Corso Riggs&mdash;"The Peace Brigade"<ref name="The Peace Brigade" /> and "In Harm's Way."<ref name="In Harm's Way" /> The weapon was originally going to be mentioned by Riggs in "Just Desserts," a Smuggler mission on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], but the section of dialogue that contained the mention was removed from the final game. The cut dialogue has Riggs offer the weapon to the Smuggler and indicates that Sergeant Boom-Boom was an intimidating weapon in his [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. Riggs also referred to the weapon with a male pronoun and used the nickname "Sergeant Boom" in the removed dialogue.<ref name="Just Desserts">{{TORcite|type=class|Smuggler|Just Desserts|Corellia}}, dialogue files for [[Unidentified Republic guard|Republic guard]]</ref> Despite multiple mentions in the game's dialogue, the weapon type of Sergeant Boom-Boom was never specified.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>
